summary: Space Gate Odyssey is a mid-weight sci-fi euro where players route settlers through a network of space gates and worker-placement stations to colonize exoplanets, balancing action efficiency against the routes rivals are also trying to build. It's more about optimizing your own network and timing than direct confrontation.
praised: distinctive gate/flow network-building puzzle not seen in many other euros
solid production and a satisfying sense of expansion
decent depth for its mid-weight footprint
criticised: theme feels pasted onto a fairly abstract engine
rules overhead is a bit much for how dry the play experience is
worker placement spots can create some downtime

interaction.kind: competing for limited worker-placement spots and shared exoplanet slots
interaction.detail: Players compete for the same limited action spaces and settlement slots on shared exoplanets, so timing and spot-blocking matter, but most of a turn is spent optimizing your own network of gates and route bonuses. The shared elements are the contested placement spots and planet slots, while engine efficiency is built on each player's own tableau.
interaction.said: unknown — described by euro-gamers as a tight, efficient network/flow-management puzzle rather than a conflict game

subsystems: exoplanet settlement pattern scoring (per-planet variable rules)
scoring.how_you_win: Send settlers through the gates to build the best patterns on each exoplanet (each scored by its own variable rule), complete moon achievements, and climb the command station track; highest combined total at game end wins.
